mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity valuations, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% by more than 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, compressing the equity risk premium and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth falls below 0.5% annually, it signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting anticipated monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 50k and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 50k and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply-side activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
